ipa.financial_contracts.cds.PremiumLegDefinition

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cds.PremiumLegDefinition.

Syntax

PremiumLegDefinition(
    *,
    direction: Direction | str = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    fixed_rate_percent: float | None = None,
    interest_payment_frequency: Frequency | str = None,
    interest_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    accrued_calculation_method: DayCountBasis | str = None,
    payment_business_day_convention: BusinessDayConvention | str = None,
    first_regular_payment_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    last_regular_payment_date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
    payment_business_days: str | None = None,
    stub_rule: StubRule | str = None,
    accrued_paid_on_default: bool | None = None,
    interest_payment_ccy: str | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
direction Direction | str No None The direction of the leg.
notional_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the notional currency. Mandatory if instrument code or instrument style has not been defined. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value may comes from the reference data.
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of the leg at the period start date. Optional. By default 1,000,000 is used.
fixed_rate_percent float | None No None The fixed coupon rate in percentage. It is mandatory in case of a single leg instrument. Otherwise, in case of multi leg instrument, it can be computed as the Par rate.
interest_payment_frequency Frequency | str No None The frequency of the interest payments. Optional if an instrument code/style have been defined : in that case, value comes from reference data. Otherwise, it is mandatory.
interest_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the coupon interest payments. Mandatory.
accrued_calculation_method DayCountBasis | str No None The Day Count Basis method used to calculate the accrued interest payments. Optional. By default, the same value than interest_calculation_method is used.
payment_business_day_convention BusinessDayConvention | str No None The method to adjust dates to a working day. Optional. In case an instrument code/style has been defined, value comes from bond reference data. Otherwise 'ModifiedFollowing' is used.
first_regular_payment_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The first regular coupon payment date for leg with an odd first coupon. Optional.
last_regular_payment_date str | date | datetime | timedelta | None No None The last regular coupon payment date for leg with an odd last coupon. Optional.
payment_business_days str | None No None A list of coma-separated calendar codes to adjust dates (e.g. 'EMU' or 'USA'). Optional. By default the calendar associated to notional_ccy is used.
stub_rule StubRule | str No None The rule that defines whether coupon roll dates are aligned on the maturity or the issue date. Optional. By default 'Maturity' is used.
accrued_paid_on_default bool | None No None Specifies whether the accrued is paid at the credit event date or not.
- true : the accrued is paid at the credit event date
- false : the accrued is not paid at the credit event date Optional. Defaults
to false.
interest_payment_ccy str | None No None The ISO code of the interest payment currency. Mandatory.
